text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hoping it would offer a change of pace for Smart Falcon, who's been in a slump lately, we came to the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I prayed to the gods for her slump to end
and drew a fortune slip, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer-san. I know gods
are mysterious beings and all, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"They're so famous that everyone knows them, so
I wonder if they're on Umastagram?"
choice_data_list: What are you saying all of a sudden...?
What are you saying all of a sudden...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: To aim for top umadol, Falco really, truly wants to get energized, so...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "I just wanted to show God how cute Falco is!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: If you do that, your wish might come true way faster than just praying, right? ☆
choice_data_list: ...I don't think they've done it, for now.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I see... In that case,
it might be tough to interact with them directly...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it's just a one-way street from Falco,
I wonder if there's some way I can make an appeal—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!!
Over there—that's where you tie fortune slips, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco just had a great idea!
Wait right here, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying that, Smart Falcon pulled out a felt-tip pen and wrote something on the fortune slip she had just drawn...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Dear God, please cheer Falco up! ☆"
...Yup, super cute!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"All that's left is to tie this to the fortune rack!
I'm sure the gods will take notice☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Falco's gonna tie it up!
I'll make it a cute heart shape♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehehe.
All done, all done♪"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You know... dear God.
Falco put all of her heart and soul into this.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"So please, God...!
Give me all the energy you've got!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether her wish was heard or not...
Smart Falcon's slump was cleared up a few days later!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Aaaahhh?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: N... no...! My fortune ripped...!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: At this rate, I won't be able to show the gods... how cute Falco is~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps the shock was simply too great...
Smart Falcon's slump ended up
continuing unresolved.
